description: Get aggregated outcome rollups for a course — one score per student per outcome, or, with aggregate="course", a single course-level mean or median — optionally filtered by user_ids and outcome_ids and sorted by student or by one outcome's score. Set include_courses to nest course details under linked.courses. When CANVAS_PSEUDONYMIZE_STUDENTS is enabled, linked.users entries are anonymized; use resolve_pseudonym to map one back to a real user. Use get_outcome_results instead for the raw per-alignment scores behind a rollup, or get_outcome_mastery_distribution for a mastery-level histogram across students.

add_defaults.description: Include default mastery colors and levels when Canvas supports it.

aggregate.description: Aggregate all student rollups into a single course-level rollup.

exclude.description: Optional rollup exclusions for missing users or missing outcome results.

include_courses.description: Include linked course details in the response payload.

outcome_ids.description: Optional outcome IDs to restrict the rollups.

sort_by.description: Sort rollups by student name or by a specific outcome score.

sort_order.description: Sort order to apply when sorting rollups.

sort_outcome_id.description: Outcome ID to sort by when sort_by="outcome".

user_ids.description: Optional Canvas user IDs (pass large IDs as strings) or SIS user IDs prefixed with "sis_user_id:".

name: get_outcome_rollups
title: Get Outcome Rollups
